stateKeys.name: loaded
stateKeys.type: boolean — true once project state has been loaded successfully (LOAD_STATE accepted); never cleared

specialRules.name: load-only-from-loading
specialRules.note: LOAD_STATE applies only while loading; it sets loaded=true.

specialRules.name: submit-only-when-ready-or-prompting
specialRules.note: SUBMIT_PROMPT enters processing from ready or prompting.

specialRules.name: complete-only-when-processing
specialRules.note: COMPLETE_RESPONSE returns to ready only from processing.

specialRules.name: already-in-error
specialRules.note: APP_ERROR from error is an observable no-op — errors do not stack.

designNotes: recovery-cannot-skip-loading — DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE from the legacy appFsm, which sent every RECOVER to ready, including errors raised before project state ever loaded, yielding a 'ready' app with nothing loaded. Here an ACCEPTED RECOVER returns to ready only when loaded==true; otherwise it returns to loading to retry the load. This is accepted-transition routing, not a rejection, so it lives here rather than in specialRules (the reject-reason vocabulary).
noOpRule: An action that does not apply in the current state is reject(reason) — an observable no-op with post == pre, never a throw and never a silent return.
